excerpt: Why Multilingual Talent Matters and How to Source It Efficiently in Canada Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. Labour shortages are no longer a temporary challenge in Canada. They are a structural reality. From construction and manufacturing to hospitality, agriculture, and healthcare, major employers across the country are struggling to find enough qualified workers. But while job vacancies keep rising, the talent pool remains limited, especially for skilled roles. This is where recruitment agencies play a critical role in helping large Canadian companies close the gap between workforce needs
